PreciseMovement.why: Puts extremely precise movement skips into logic.

ProficientCombat.why: Puts skips that need proficient combat into logic.

ObscureSkips.why: Puts skips that a beginner would not know into logic.

ShadeSkips.why: Puts shade pogo and damage boost skips into logic.

InfectionSkips.why: Puts skips that only work after the Crossroads are infected into logic.

FireballSkips.why: Puts skips that reset fall speed with spells into logic.

SpikeTunnels.why: Puts narrow spike tunnels into logic.

AcidSkips.why: Puts crossing acid without Isma's Tear into logic.

DamageBoosts.why: Puts skips that need you to take damage into logic.

DangerousSkips.why: Puts skips with a high risk of damage into logic.

DarkRooms.why: Puts dark rooms without the Lumafly Lantern into logic.

ComplexSkips.why: Puts skips with intense setup into logic.

DifficultSkips.why: Puts skips harder than typical into logic.

DeathLink.why: When any player dies, everyone dies.

accessibility.why: Minimal accessibility only promises the goal can be finished.
